Official Policy

Privacy Policy for EduPulse Student Hub

Last Updated: October 2026

EduPulse ("we", "our", or "the app") is designed to provide college students and instructors with a modern, secure, and privacy-respecting academic productivity platform.

1. Information We Collect & Store

EduPulse collects and stores only the information necessary to provide study management features:

  • Student Profile: Name, institutional email, student ID, major, and current academic semester.
  • Coursework & Tasks: Assignments, descriptions, submission statuses, priority levels, study tasks, and personal notes.
  • Timetable & Schedules: Course codes, room numbers, lecture timings, and faculty names.
  • Notification Preferences: Customized reminder intervals, alarm sound toggles, and scheduled deadline alerts.

2. Local Storage & Cloud Sync

By default, EduPulse stores your academic data locally on your device using encrypted browser persistent storage (Local Storage). If cloud synchronization (Supabase) is enabled, your data is transmitted over secure HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and protected by Row Level Security (RLS) policies ensuring only your authenticated account can access your coursework.

3. Device Permissions & Why We Need Them

  • Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Required to alert you when assignment deadlines approach and study sessions are scheduled.
  • Exact Alarms (SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM): Required to deliver timely deadline reminders even when the app is minimized.
  • Vibrate & Wake Lock: Used solely to alert you during scheduled alarms.

4. Data Sharing & Third Parties

We never sell, rent, or trade your personal or academic information to third parties, advertisers, or data brokers.

5. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact the EduPulse team at:
Email: support@edupulse.studenthub.edu
